sources.entry: BibDesk - Use BibDesk to edit and manage your bibliography

summary.name: BibDesk
summary.one_liner: BibDesk is a graphical BibTeX bibliography manager for Mac OS X.
use_cases: Managing BibTeX references for LaTeX papers
Finding references in a bibliography library
Organizing linked PDFs alongside citation records
Editing a bibliography on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: BibDesk is a graphical bibliography manager built around the BibTeX format on Mac OS X. The page lists features for managing BibTeX references, finding references, importing references and exporting references. Page text also includes developer changelog-style notes about fixing date parsing of the date-added field and resolving linked file URLs from bookmark data. User reviews describe it as a long-running open source reference manager that handles dropping PDFs and works well on M1 Macs. The page does not give detailed technical specifications.
notable: Open source under the BSD License
Graphical front end for BibTeX bibliography files
Links to PDF files and resolves linked file URLs from bookmark data
caveats: The page does not mention any paid tier; it is listed as BSD licensed open source
Metadata scanning is not available according to one user review, which says it is the one missing feature
